title: {{list_tool}} — output
description: Output schema for the SOX list_channels (discovery) operation. Returns all channels with at least one subscriber or at least one message in the backing store's retention window (default: last 24 hours). Also exposes the MCP server's protocol_version so adapters can detect major-version mismatches at startup. Normative reference: CONTRACTS.md §5.4 and §8.

channels.description: List of discoverable channels. An empty array means no channels are currently active.

subscriber_count.description: Number of agents currently subscribed to this channel.

protocol_version.description: Protocol version advertised by this MCP server node (e.g. '1.0'). Adapters MUST compare the MAJOR component of this value against their own expected major version and refuse to operate on a mismatch. See CONTRACTS.md §8 for the versioning policy.
